# War Scroll Column 12 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 12 | **Condition:** complete

---

**12:1** Blessed be the God of Israel, who keeps covenant-faithfulness with His covenant and the appointed times of salvation for the people He has redeemed. He has called those who stumble

**12:2** to wonderful mighty deeds, and He has gathered the assembly of the nations for destruction without remnant. He has exalted in judgment

**12:3** the fainthearted, and He has opened the mouth of the mute for joyful song. He has taught feeble hands to wage war,

**12:4** and He has girded trembling knees with strength to stand. Through the poor in spirit shall the hard of heart be

**12:5** judged, and by those who are perfect in the way shall all the wicked nations come to an end. None of their mighty warriors shall stand,

**12:6** for the God of Israel and the angel of His truth help all the Sons of Light. For You created Belial

**12:7** for the pit, an angel of enmity; in darkness is his dominion, and his counsel is to bring about wickedness and guilt. All the spirits

**12:8** of his lot are angels of destruction; they walk according to the statutes of darkness, and toward it is their common desire. But we,

**12:9** the lot of Your truth, rejoice in Your mighty hand. We are glad in Your salvation, and we exult

**12:10** in Your strength and Your peace. Who is like You in strength, O God of Israel? With the lowly is

**12:11** the hand of Your might. What angel or prince can compare to the help of Your presence? For You

**12:12** appointed the day of battle from of old [...] to aid truth and to destroy guilt, to bring low darkness

**12:13** and to exalt light, to establish [...] an eternal station, and to destroy all the Sons of Darkness, that there may be joy

**12:14** for all the Sons of Light. As the fire of His wrath burns against the idols of Egypt,

**12:15** so shall You act against [...] For You are the God of our fathers; we bless Your name forever.

**12:16** We are the people of Your inheritance; You made a covenant with our fathers, and You shall establish it for their descendants

**12:17** throughout the appointed times of eternity. In all the appointed times of Your glory there has been a remembrance of Your covenant-faithfulness among us, as a help to the remnant and the survivors of Your covenant, to recount Your deeds of truth and the judgments of Your wondrous mighty deeds.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 12 is the thanksgiving hymn following the first engagement. "Covenant-faithfulness" (hesed) preserved as established convention. The dualism between Light and Darkness (12:6-14) is the theological heart of the column. "Poor in spirit" (12:4) is a significant parallel to the Beatitudes. The final lines (16-17) are covenantal affirmation.*
